name: Tôm bột
summary: Tôm bột is a different prawn from tôm sú, and tôm bột biển is its own order.
howToEat: Order it by weight. Island seafood is at its best in winter, before the spring spawn.
where: Đường 1/4 and đường Núi Ngọc, the two seafood streets of Cát Bà town.
seoDescription: Tôm bột is a different prawn from tôm sú on đường 1/4 and đường Núi Ngọc.
